meta_description: GAMEWISE is an AI coach for CS2 that remembers how you play: it finds the mistakes you repeat match after match, shows you the evidence and proves with data whether you're improving. Free during the beta.
og_description: Your AI coach for CS2 that remembers how you play and proves with data whether you're improving. Free during the beta.
og_sub: AI coach for Counter-Strike 2 · Free in beta
hero_lead: GAMEWISE is an AI coach for Counter-Strike 2. It finds the mistakes you repeat match after match, shows you the evidence and proves with data whether you're getting better.
hero_note_steam: Sign in with Steam, no uploads
board_aria: Example: isolated fights detected in 7 of the last 10 matches.
board_coach: You commit before your team can trade you. It happens in wins and losses alike: it's not bad luck, it's a pattern.
problem_title: You play, you check your stats, and you still don't know what to practice.
pain1_text: You have all the data and no answer to the question that matters.
pain2_text: Tools tell you what happened in this match and stop there. The mistakes holding you back are the ones you repeat.
pain3_title: You can't tell if you improved.
pain3_text: You practice something for a week and have no way to check whether it worked.
stats_aria: Example of match stats that don't tell you what to practice.
stats_question: So what do I practice today?
loop_lead: GAMEWISE doesn't analyze one match in isolation: it works on the goal you choose and follows it across your matches.
loop2_d: It looks for that pattern in your matches.
loop3_d: It shows you the rounds that prove it.
loop4_d: One concrete task for your next match.
loop5_d: It compares your numbers: did you improve?
loop6_d: The loop closes and a new one starts.
loop_note: Every pattern the coach reports is tied to real rounds and events from your matches. If there's no data to back it up, it tells you.
show_title: A coach that knows you, not another report
show_lead: You work on one area at a time: aim, positioning, decision-making, utility, teamplay or consistency.
f1_title: See exactly where the mistake repeats
f1_text: Every finding comes with the rounds that back it up, and it separates what's data from your match from what's the coach's interpretation.
ev1: Entered B alone with no trade
ev3: Rotated before info and ended up 1v3
ev_coach: All three rounds share the same thing: you commit before your team can trade you.
f2_title: It remembers how you play and what you've been working on
f2_text: You talk to a coach that knows your goal, your patterns and what you've already tried. You don't start from scratch every time you open the app.
chat_q: Why do I lose so many rounds on CT?
chat_a1: On CT your aim isn't the problem: you win 58% of your duels. But in 5 of your last 8 matches you took fights where nobody could trade you.
chat_a2: It's the same thing we were working on as T. Let's keep that goal going.
f3_title: One clear task for your next match
f3_text: No more "improve your decision-making". GAMEWISE gives you a concrete action and drills for what you're missing.
task_text: Before entering a site, wait until a teammate is less than 2 seconds behind you.
f4_title: It proves with numbers whether you're improving
f4_text: Come back after a few matches and see your progress against the goal you set. Once you hit it, the loop closes and you pick your next goal.
f4_aria: Example of progress: decision-making goes from 54 to 62 over 10 matches and beats the target of 60.
diff_title: Others tell you what happened. GAMEWISE handles what comes next.
diff_r2_o: Generic mistakes, the same for everyone
diff_r4_o: No idea if your practice worked
diff_quote: Existing tools analyze matches. GAMEWISE runs your improvement loop.
plans_title: We're in beta: try it free
plans_lead: We want you to use it and tell us what helps. No credit card during the beta.
plan_b1: Analysis of your CS2 matches focused on your goal
plan_b2: AI coach that remembers your history
plan_after_1: There will still be a free plan to analyze your matches, plus paid plans for players who want more analyses and the full coach.
plan_after_2: We'll announce pricing before the beta ends. Nobody gets charged without knowing.
a1: Yes. During the beta you can use GAMEWISE for free, no card needed. Afterwards there will still be a free plan, and we'll announce paid plan pricing in advance.
q2: What do I need to get started?
a2: A Steam account with Counter-Strike 2 matches. You sign in with Steam and GAMEWISE pulls your match history from the integrated platforms.
q3: Do I have to upload demos or install anything?
a3: No. You don't upload files or install anything on your PC. Everything runs in the browser.
q4: Can I get banned for using it?
a4: GAMEWISE isn't installed on your PC, doesn't run alongside the game and doesn't touch CS2. It only reads the history of matches you've already played, like any stats site. It doesn't help you while you play: it helps you train between matches.
q5: Does GAMEWISE see my Steam password?
a5: No. Signing in takes you to Steam's official page to confirm your account. GAMEWISE never sees your password.
q6: Does it work with Premier and FACEIT?
a6: Yes. Today it pulls your matches through Leetify and FACEIT, and we're adding direct downloads from Steam.
a7: This site is in Spanish, English and Portuguese. The app is in Spanish for now; more languages are coming.
final_lead: Pick what you want to improve and start your first loop today.
tagline: Your gameplay. Your data. Your AI coach — that remembers.
